name: Walrus Audio
author: Tone Zone
description: Pedals inspired by Walrus Audio: etched-illustration enclosures in muted powder-coat colours with metallic ink. Chorus / vibrato, multi-texture reverbs, the Mako-style big-box delay / reverb / modulation / amp-sim series, five-state drives, harmonic tremolos, filter fuzz, bass preamp DI, compressor and texture machines.
